# Companion counter scope clarification

This prospectively completes the accepted v3 proposal before any final source
hold or actual scientific access. Target companions carry
`counter_scope=completed_authorized_role_parse_snapshot` and
`counter_unit=co_recorded_target_row_bundle_two_cells`. Their
`mixed_source_counter_scope=cumulative_worker_custodian_source_capture` separates
actual capture count/bytes from the authorized-role row counts. Issuance copies
the actual custodian counters; successful authenticated graph gates reconstruct
exactly one verified capture and the pinned source byte count.

The rank summary uses `local_projector_no_source_capture_or_target_decode` for
its zero row/capture counters. Allocation's existing cumulative worker counters
are zero before target phase. These scopes do not imply repeated source capture,
additional target interpretation or independent artifact resource measurements.
No numerical, source-selection, target grammar, allocation, or model choice changes.
